recipe.name: Onion rava upma
recipe.description: A South Indian semolina breakfast with sautéed onion and mustard seeds.
steps: Dry-toast the semolina over medium heat, stirring until aromatic. Set it aside.
Heat oil, add mustard seeds, then soften the finely chopped onion in the pan.
Add water and salt. When it boils, gradually stir in the toasted semolina.
Cover over low heat until the grains soften and the water is absorbed.

recipe.name: Jeera rice
recipe.description: Basmati rice fragranced with whole cumin.
steps: Rinse the rice, soak it for 20 minutes, then drain.
Warm ghee in a pot and stir in cumin until fragrant. Stir the rice through the cumin.
Add water and salt. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook over low heat until tender. Rest before fluffing.

recipe.name: Onion and tomato egg bhurji
recipe.description: Indian spiced scrambled eggs with soft onion and tomato.
steps: Dice the onion and tomato and beat the eggs in a clean bowl.
Warm the oil and cumin, soften the onion, then cook the tomato down into a thick base.
Stir in the eggs and salt, breaking up the curds as they set. Cook until no liquid egg remains and serve.

recipe.name: Chickpea sundal
recipe.description: Tamil-style tempered chickpeas tossed with grated coconut. Uses already cooked chickpeas.
steps: Drain the cooked chickpeas and grate the coconut.
Warm the oil, let the mustard seeds crackle, and stir in the chickpeas and salt.
Toss until the chickpeas are heated through, then fold in the coconut off the heat.
